title: Auth users
desc: Shared users and the OIDC identity provider of the Web service: site web auth, basic auth and apps signing in through OIDC all use these accounts
usersDesc: Takes effect on all sites and OIDC apps once saved

sites.title: Sites using shared users
sites.help: Selected sites accept shared users for web auth and basic auth, alongside their own users; selecting a site without authentication also turns on web auth. Whether an OIDC app can sign a user in is set by each client's allow list below. Clearing a site that authenticates only with shared users also turns off its authentication when saved.
sites.search: Filter by site name, domain or listener
sites.willEnableAuth: Web auth turns on when saved
sites.lockForward: Sites using forward auth cannot use shared users
sites.none: No sites that can use authentication yet
sites.disableConfirm: These sites authenticate only with shared users. Clearing them also turns off their authentication, so anyone can access them without signing in: {sites}. Save anyway?
